implemented_requirements.evidence: FileHandler.read_file reads the whole content of a text file and returns it as a string (file_handler.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect palindromic words in the text
implemented_requirements.evidence: PalindromeDetector.detect_words scans each line with a word regex and uses is_palindrome to identify palindromes (palindrome_detector.py).
PalindromeDetector.detect_phrases checks whole lines when include_phrases is True (palindrome_detector.py).
PalindromeDetector.compute_statistics aggregates totals, unique count, most frequent and longest palindrome (palindrome_detector.py).
ReportGenerator.generate builds a formatted report string using the findings and statistics (report_generator.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Command‑line interface for specifying input file and options
implemented_requirements.evidence: main.parse_arguments defines arguments – input file, output file, min‑length, case‑sensitive, include‑phrases (main.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Write report to an optional output file
implemented_requirements.evidence: FileHandler.write_file is called when an output path is supplied (main.py).

judge.summary: The repository contains a complete, runnable implementation that reads a text file, detects palindromic words (and optionally whole‑line phrases), computes useful statistics, and produces a formatted report printed to the console and optionally saved to disk. All core requirements are satisfied with coherent code and no evident blocking bugs.
